Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Tassled Criss-Cross Wool Area Rug, 5 x 8 Foot, Blue and White
Materials: wool
80% Wool 20% Cotton Imported Cool shades of blue and cream crisscross in a whimsical pattern, setting a pleasurable tone to interior spaces. This luxurious texture will generate many compliments for its sophisticated, harmonious coordination with a variety of furniture. 5' x 8' Hand-tufted in India Medium pile height makes it durable and easy to vacuum Vacuum, professionally clean Pair with a rug pad, which is sold separately Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
